race.description: Amora Hotel Brisbane Summer Scorcher Series Hcp (C4)
race.comment: STRAAND BEAUTY (2) followed up on his two strong trials in readiness with a bold first-up run at Eagle Farm, when only getting collared late. He now comes back from Saturday company and stays at a trip he relishes. Will prove even tougher to run down this time. CABALETTO (7) brings a progressive winning platform, having scored dominantly last time at Eagle Farm. Has enough pace to offset the wide alley and keeps gun hoop Maloney in the saddle. Have to respect. TEN TRINITY SQUARE (5) returns and is unbeaten over this trip from three starts. The 714-day layoff raises concerns, but two trials and a close second at Deagon are promising. PARETO (1) is warming nicely into this prep and now gets the blinkers first time as he drops back to a trip he relishes. Draws the inside and benefits from a 3kg claim. Ticks a few boxes and is worth some thought.
